senses.def: An interjection in response to smelling an unpleasant scent.
ex: What is that awful smell? P U!

senses.def: any of various polymers containing the urethane radical; a wide variety of synthetic forms are made and used as adhesives or plastics or paints or rubber

a solid silvery grey radioactive transuranic element whose atoms can be split when bombarded with neutrons; found in minute quantities in uranium ores but is usually synthesized in nuclear reactors; 13 isotopes are known with the most important being plutonium 239
A county of Linfen, Shanxi, China.
